entities.name: Czesław Cyraniak
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Czesław Cyraniak was a Polish boxer who competed in the 1936 Summer Olympics. Born in Poznań, in 1936 he was eliminated in the second round of the lightweight class after losing his fight to José Padilla. Cyraniak fought in the Polish Army in the September Campaign and died in the Battle of Bzura.

entities.summary: Czesław Cyraniak was a Polish boxer who competed in the 1936 Summer Olympics. Born in Poznań, in 1936 he was eliminated in the second round of the lightweight class after losing his fight to José Padilla. Cyraniak fought in the Polish Army in the September Campaign and died in the Battle of Bzura.
